name: Image-Based Rendering for Subvolumes
definition: An image-based rendering scheme to accelerate rendering by caching slab images and reusing them for novel frames, deciding whether to re-render or reuse based on a priority value.
summary: Image-Based Rendering for Subvolumes accelerates volume visualization by caching and reusing pre-rendered slab images for distant subvolumes, distinguishing itself from surface-based methods by operating directly on volumetric data.
